title: Hente Dekho Kolkata
subtitle: Clay and colour in Kumortuli, time beside the river, rooms of light at Metcalfe Hall and festive city streets.
location: Kumortuli · Hooghly riverfront · College Street · Metcalfe Hall · Park Street

cover.alt: A small lamp lighting yellow faces as an artisan works between the figures.
cover.caption: A small lamp lighting yellow faces as an artisan works between the figures.

chapters.title: Through the workshops of Kumortuli
paragraphs: Weathered balconies overlook lanes lined with clay figures. Inside the workshops, artisans paint faces and finish the small details under bamboo rafters and warm lamps.

chapters.title: Yellow, red and a day of puja
paragraphs: Saraswati shrines, colourful wall art and yellow saris mark the celebrations. The walk continues past the white columns of Medical College.
